title: PetMod
description: A mod that adds custom flying pets
body:
# PetMod

This mod adds pets that fly after you throughout the world. Use the settings to change their size, gravity, name, skin — **whatever you want**.

_The mod runs entirely on the client side: other players cannot see your pets._
